names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος», with the rank word and the office left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first entry for the Julian 19 March on pravoslavno.rs, whose heading is „Свети мученици Хрисант и Дарија, и други с њима.“, where the form is named in the body as the torturer who was converted by what he saw. The rank words Свети мученици stand at the head of the whole company and are left off, and nothing on the page gives this man an epithet or a city, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the name link behind this saint's place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 марта ст. ст., «Клавдий Римский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name and gives no city.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for him: «Când împăratul Numerian (283-284) a aflat de acest lucru, a dat ordin ca toți să fie executați». The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year of death.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Хрисанфа и Дарии и с ними мчч. Клавдия трибуна, Иларии, жены его, Иасона и Мавра, сынов их, Диодора пресвитера и Мариана диакона (283).»

attestations.note: The line ranks him трибуна, the tribune who was set to torture the first of the company and was converted by it, and the life has him drowned in the sea. The line enumerates all eight of the company by name and closes «(283)», the year this folder already held, and the life page behind it puts the executions under Numerian, «(283 - 284)», which is the interval the corpus already records for the companions. The eight name links are the only place this calendar gives the by-name Римский, which the day's own declined line does not. The day page prints no hymn for any of the eight.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 19 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Claudiu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The day's line names the household of four and the page gives each of them a heading of his own and a couplet — one for Claudius, one for Hilaria, one for Maurus and Jason together. It dates only his office: «Ο Κλαύδιος ήταν Τριβούνος στο αξίωμα στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Νουμεριανου (283 - 284 μ.Χ.)», which is the same reign the corpus's interval already rests on, so no year has been changed.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.04.2026 (19. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Хрисант и Дарија, и други с њима.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the other calendars already keep in these folders, and the same company: Rome, the reign of Numerian, the torturer who was converted by what he saw and died with his household, and Chrysanthus and Daria buried alive under stones. The heading names two and then „и други с њима“, and the body names three more — Claudius, Diodorus the priest and Marianus the deacon — and describes, without naming, Claudius's wife and his two sons. All eight folders the corpus already holds on this day take a row, which is how the rows already in them were written: saint.gr's own line for this family names all four of them together, and its line for the clergy names the other two. The Prologue's „283. и 284. године“ is the pair of years these folders already hold, so no date was touched. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
